title: Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces
abstract: arXiv:2611.26464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Set pieces produce about a third of non-penalty expected goals (xG), yet they are usually evaluated by what happened next. We present Monte Carlo Pass Search (MCPS) for set pieces, which treats a corner or a lofted free kick as a distribution over plausible executions and plausible futures instead of a single realised event. From the pre-kick state, MCPS proposes counterfactual deliveries and counterfactual set-ups (where the attackers stand at the kick), plays each out many times in a world model (3D ball physics, a generative model of all 22 players, the keeper's come-or-stay decision and a Player-to-Touch model) and scores every future with a value model. On 249 deliveries from 30 Serie A 2025/26 matches, with every model applied only to matches it never saw, the best available delivery is worth 0.0085 xG more than the one kicked (+28 %), mainly because it reaches an attacker before the keeper. translated_title: 用于定位球的蒙特卡洛传球搜索
translated_abstract: 定位球贡献了约三分之一的非点球预期进球（xG），然而它们通常只根据随后实际发生的情况来评估。我们提出了用于定位球的蒙特卡洛传球搜索（MCPS），该方法将角球或高吊任意球视为由合理执行方式和合理后续发展构成的分布，而非单一已实现的事件。从开球前的状态出发，MCPS提出反事实的传球方案和反事实的站位布置（即开球时进攻球员的站位），在包含三维球体物理、全部22名球员的生成模型、守门员出击或留守决策以及球员触球模型的世界模型中对每种方案进行多次推演，并用价值模型为每一种可能的未来打分。在来自2025/26赛季意甲30场比赛的249次传球上（所有模型仅应用于其从未见过的比赛），最佳可用传球的价值比实际踢出的传球高出0.0085 xG（提升28%），主要原因在于它能在守门员之前将球送到进攻球员脚下。通过搜索进攻球员的站位……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出蒙特卡洛传球搜索（MCPS），借助世界模型对定位球的反事实传球方案和进攻站位进行大规模推演与价值评估，发现意甲比赛中最佳可用传球比实际踢出的传球多出0.0085 xG（提升28%）。
en_tdlr: Monte Carlo Pass Search (MCPS) simulates counterfactual deliveries and attacker set-ups for set pieces in a world model, showing that the best available delivery in Serie A matches is worth 0.0085 more xG (+28%) than the one actually kicked.
